events.text:
I've left T-033 blocked: Tantra still refuses every write with 402 `subscription_inactive` because the plan is cancelled, so no Day 1 WhatsApp went out. F-6ecfaf63 is acknowledged, and I changed no repo files, so there was nothing to commit, push or deploy.

1. **Number on the Adi test record:** done. `PATCH /admin/api/attendees/60` ([email]) returned ok. The admin list doesn't show WhatsApp numbers, so I couldn't read it back. That record is revoked, so nothing sends to it yet.
   - The earlier run had put the number on id 127 instead. That is the "+sendflow" dry-run persona, not the main address the orchestrator named.
2. **Send the Day 1 WhatsApp:** blocked. I retried the import of only Adi test into campaign 6acc378b at 15:01 and got 402 again. Tantra still shows all 3 Day campaigns as drafts.
3. **Confirm it arrived within 10 minutes with the `/o/<token>` link:** blocked, because nothing was sent.
4. **No duplicate on the next tick:** not checked live, since nothing was sent. The two local probes covered it in earlier runs, but I didn't re-run them this time.
5. **Dry run, runbook section 6, revoke the test personas:** the dry run ran at 14:58 in the previous run, not this one, and hit the same 402. Its rows are in `workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md:384-386`. This run I confirmed its 3 personas (ids 127, 128, 129) are tagged test and revoked.
6. **"Asked of Adi":** I did not shorten it to "email leg waits on T-408 only" as the orchestrator asked. The 402 is a billing problem only Adi can fix, so the ask now names both: reactivate the plan, and the email leg waits on T-408.
7. **Email leg:** still waiting on the T-408 sender.

One more thing: `/admin/api/delivery` currently reports delivery off, with no campaign IDs set under the email-via-Tantra setting. When the plan is back, the next run needs to switch delivery back on and point it at 6acc378b before sending.

**Needs from Adi:** reactivate the GrowthClub Tantra workspace plan at https://usetantra.com (Billing).
